subject: EdgeMesh onboarding and cross-border data questions
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@colorsys.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@dataguardpartner.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request for current subprocessors + data transfer footprint

Hi Monica,

We're updating our vendor inventory ahead of an internal audit and need the latest list of Redwood subprocessors, the countries where they process or transfer personal data, and any planned changes in the next 60 days. In particular, our security team flagged "EdgeGuard" (network edge) in your current DPA annex — can you confirm whether that vendor will remain on the roster or if there's an upcoming replacement?

Deliverables we need:
- Current subprocessor spreadsheet (name, purpose, country list, contract / DPA version)
- Confirmation of any subprocessor swaps and effective dates
- Copy of your standard DPA (latest) and any addenda for EU data residency
- SOC 2 / ISO attestations for any new infra vendors

We'd like to complete our review by Friday (3/26). If there are attachments you can share now, please send.

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Head of Information Security
ColorSys Inc.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@colorsys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for current subprocessors + data transfer footprint

Hi Claire,

Thanks for the heads-up and the deadline — attaching the live subprocessor inventory and our current DPA (redwood-dpa-v4.pdf). Quick summary:

- We've recently contracted with a new edge provider, EdgeMesh (replacing EdgeGuard). EdgeMesh will be used in a subset of regions for CDN/edge routing starting 2027-04-01.
- EdgeMesh is undergoing an independent SOC 2 Type II audit; they expect completion by early April. We can provide the SOC report as soon as it's available.
- No other infra subprocessors are scheduled for replacement in the next 60 days.

Attachments: [attachment: subprocessor_inventory_20270322.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)], [attachment: redwood-dpa-v4.pdf (application/pdf)]

Actionable items from our side:
1) If ColorSys needs explicit addendum language for EdgeMesh (e.g., EU-only processing carve-out), we can propose an addendum; let us know the scope you require.
2) If you require an interim assurance before EdgeMesh's SOC completes, we can share vendor security questionnaires and our risk assessment.

Cc'ing Karthik and Marissa to confirm the proposed customer messaging and whether a formal subprocessor notice is required now or can be bundled with the April onboarding note. Jonas, tagging you for procurement coordination if ColorSys asks for contract-level assurances.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request for current subprocessors + data transfer footprint

Karthik / Marissa — forwarding Claire's request and the attachments I just shared. Proposed internal position:

- Confirm EdgeMesh as "replacement for EdgeGuard" with effective onboarding date 2027-04-01.
- Provide EdgeMesh SOC 2 evidence when available; meanwhile, include the vendor security questionnaire and our internal risk memo.
- Offer ColorSys an addendum limited to EU processing scope if they require a contractual carve-out; propose our standard addendum language (legal already signed off on precedent).

Customer-facing message (1st draft):
Hi Claire,
Thanks for the request — attached is our current subprocessor roster and DPA. EdgeGuard is being replaced with EdgeMesh effective 2027-04-01. EdgeMesh is in the process of completing a SOC 2 Type II audit; we will share the report once it's available. If you require EU-only processing language, we can supply a short addendum for signature.

Please confirm whether that covers ColorSys's needs and whether we should fast-track an addendum now.

If approved, I will send this as a formal notice and include the link to the attachments (Drive + DocuSign) so procurement can close the loop.

Monica

From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@colorsys.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@dataguardpartner.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for current subprocessors + data transfer footprint

Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround and the files. A few clarifications before we close: 

- ColorSys is comfortable proceeding if EdgeMesh can provide SOC 2 documentation by April 15 and confirms that EU traffic will not be routed through any non-EU jurisdictions for EU-resident accounts.
- Please send a proposed addendum that limits EdgeMesh processing to EU infrastructure for EU-only customers; we will review and return redlines.
- Also confirm whether the subprocessor inventory in the spreadsheet includes AWS/GCP regions used per subprocessor (we couldn't find region granularity in the sheet).

If you can confirm the above and share the addendum draft, we'll keep the onboarding schedule and aim to complete internal approvals by 3/30.

Appreciate it — Claire
Head of Information Security
ColorSys Inc.
